name: Early IT Summer Camp (University of Cincinnati)
org: University of Cincinnati School of Information Technology
what_you_do: Attend a free day camp. Learn cybersecurity, software development, game development and data and cloud technologies. Hear from IT leaders. Build a team project with a college student mentor.
who_can_apply: High school students who like technology. The camp page does not state a grade range.
pay_detail: Free to attend. A light breakfast and lunch are provided each day. No pay.
duration: June 1 to June 18, Monday to Friday, 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. The page does not state a year and calls it a one three-week day camp.
deadline_text: The camp page has a Registration is Now Open notice for June 1 to 18, Monday to Friday. Spots are first come, first served. The page shows no year and no closing date, so a teen cannot tell which summer it means. Ask the program to confirm the year before applying.
how_to_apply: Use the Register Here link on the Early IT Summer Camp page. Tell them in your application if cost or lack of resources could keep you from taking part. Questions: ucearlyit@ucmail.uc.edu. There is a parent or guardian orientation on Zoom.
notes: The camp page has a Registration is Now Open notice, but it gives no closing date and no year for the June 1 to 18 dates, so the status stays closed-expect-reopen until the year is confirmed. The page says the camp is offered at no charge to students. Check the dates and status before sending a teen.
